_comment: Stage B multiplayer config. `test_budgets` is Wave 0 lane 0.F's net harness budgets (docs/specs/MP_NET_HARNESS_CONTRACT.md §8), read by tests/helpers/net_harness.gd::_init_budgets(). `session` is Wave 2 lane 2.A's transport and handshake tunables (D95), read by scripts/net/session.gd::config(). Missing keys fall back to each reader's own defaults, so a partial edit here is safe.

session._comment_port: Default UDP port Session.host() binds and Session.join() dials when a caller names none. D95: direct IP, no relay, no Steam.
session._comment_max_peers: D95's peer cap: the host plus three joiners. ENetMultiplayerPeer.create_server() takes the number of CLIENTS, so session.gd passes max_peers - 1.
session._comment_channel_count: D95's two channels: transfer_channel 1 carries ledger/encounter traffic, transfer_channel 2 carries snapshots, so a late-join snapshot never queues behind movement. Godot reserves three system channels of its own beneath these.
session._comment_connect_timeout_s: Wall-clock seconds Session.join() waits for the ENet connection itself before giving up.
session._comment_handshake_timeout_s: Wall-clock seconds a joiner waits for the host's world snapshot after connecting. Generous because the host may be mid-frame on a Meadows scene that spike S2 measured at ~85 s to build.
session._comment_reconnect_window_s: How long a dropped character id keeps its registry row for a rejoin. Wave 2 keeps the row for the process lifetime and reads this only as the documented intent; the timed eviction lands with Wave 5's downed/revive window.
session._comment_clock_sync_interval_s: D105: how often the host broadcasts `day` and `clock_elapsed_seconds` as host truth. One second is far finer than the 600 s in-game day, so a client's sky never visibly steps.

test_budgets._comment_step_budget_frames: Default per-step budget, contract §4/§6, physics frames.
test_budgets._comment_hello_budget_s: Wall-clock seconds every peer has to connect and say hello after launch. Spike S2 (ralph/reports/MP-0D-SPIKE-HOSTCOST-0905/) measured a cold Meadows boot at ~85s per peer; both peers boot concurrently on one runner, so 180s is real margin, not the raw number doubled blind.
test_budgets._comment_smoke_step_budget_s_2peer: Wall-clock seconds of STEPS a 2-peer smoke may spend, timed from the moment launch()'s hello wait succeeds -- separate from hello_budget_s on purpose, so a slow boot cannot eat into what a smoke's own assertions need.
test_budgets._comment_smoke_step_budget_s_wide: Same, for 3/4-peer runs -- nightly/owner-kit only, never PR CI (contract §10); spike S2 measured four full boots at 12.85 GB, which does not fit beside PR CI on a 16 GB runner.
test_budgets._comment_heartbeat_frames: Physics frames between peer heartbeats, contract §3/§7.
test_budgets._comment_desync_frames: Consecutive frames of no common state_hash before the desync detector fails the run, contract §7.
test_budgets._comment_near_tolerance: Position tolerances for the `near` assert and movement smokes, contract §8 -- provisional until 2.C measures interpolation lag.
